title: Measuring EGFR plasma membrane density, stability, internalization, and recycling in alive adherent cells by cell surface ELISA
protocol: Wash cells once with pre-warmed PBS++ at 37°C.
Starve cells for 2 h in pre-warmed 0.5% FBS-DMEM media (0.5 mL/well) at 37°C.
Assess cell condition by light microscope after starvation.
Place the plate on ice for 5–10 min to impede receptor internalization.
Add 300 μL/well of EGFR primary Ab diluted 1:1000 (i.e., a final Ab concentration of 1 μg/mL) in ice cold 0.5% BSA/PBS++ and incubate for 1 h on ice.
Use an IgG isotype control as a background signal control.
Wash cells three times with ice cold PBS++ (500 μL/well) gently and quickly to avoid cell detachment.
Aspirate the wash solution from the wells using an aspirator.
Add 300 μL/well of HRP-conjugated F(ab')2 secondary Ab diluted 1:1500 in ice cold 0.5% BSA/PBS++.
Incubate for 1 hour on ice.
Wash cells at least four times with ice cold PBS++ (500 μL/well).
Prepare Amplex Red reagent dilution as follows (for 10 mL): mix 9.85 mL of ice cold 1× PBS, 50 μL of 10 mM stock Amplex Red reagent, and 100 μL of 20 mM H2O2.
Prepare 10 mM stock Amplex Red reagent according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Aliquot and store the stock Amplex Red reagent at −20°C protected from light.
Dilute 3% H2O2 stock solution in appropriate volume of dH2O to prepare a 20 mM working solution (1 mL = 23 μL of 3% H2O2 + 977 μL of dH2O).
Add 300 μL/well of the prepared Amplex Red reagent dilution.
Incubate for 10 min on ice, protected from light.
Transfer 200 μL of the incubated mixture to a 96 well BLACK plate.
Increase washes to 6 times after secondary Ab incubation if background signal is high.
Add Amplex Red reagent again in case of increased washing.
Subtract the average signal from IgG wells (background) from each well labeled for EGFR.
Seed cells in two 24-well plates, one for EGF stimulation and the other unstimulated.
Starve cells for 2 hours in 0.5% FBS-DMEM media prewarmed at 37°C.
Stimulate one plate with EGF (50 ng/mL) prepared in 0.5% FBS-DMEM media for 20 minutes at 37°C.
Wash the stimulated and unstimulated plates twice with PBS++.
Place both plates on ice for 5–10 minutes to impede receptor internalization.
Label receptors as described for cell surface density measurement.
Seed cells in two 24-well plates: one for EGF stimulation, the other unstimulated.
Starve cells for 2 hours in 0.5% FBS-DMEM media pre-warmed at 37°C.
Stimulate one plate with 50 ng/mL EGF prepared in 0.5% FBS-DMEM media for 5 minutes at 37°C.
Leave the second plate unstimulated.
Wash both plates twice with PBS++ and place them on ice for 5 to 10 minutes.
Measure fluorescence as described for cell surface density measurement.
Analyze cell surface receptor internalization as described for cell surface stability measurement.
Seed cells in quadruplets in plate one (P1) without inducing receptor internalization.
Seed cells in quadruplets in plate two (P2) with induced receptor internalization but no blocking.
Seed cells in quadruplets in plate three (P3) with induced receptor internalization and blocking, but no recycling.
Seed cells in quadruplets in plate four (P4) with induced receptor internalization and blocking, followed by triggering of recycling.
Seed cells in quadruplets in plate five (P5) without inducing receptor internalization but with a different antibody labeling including a blocking step.
Place plates on ice for 5–10 minutes to impede receptor internalization.
Add 300 μL/well of rat anti-EGFR primary Ab diluted 1:1000 in ice cold 0.5% BSA/PBS++ and incubate for 1 hour on ice.
Wash cells three times with ice cold PBS++ (0.5 mL/well).
Add 1 mL of pre-warmed complete media to P2, P3, and P4 and incubate for 10 minutes at 37°C to internalize receptors.
Place P2, P3, and P4 on ice for 5–10 minutes to stop receptor internalization.
Wash P2, P3, and P4 once with ice cold PBS++ (0.5 mL/well) on ice.
Add 300 μL/well of mouse anti-rat unconjugated monovalent F(ab’)2 secondary Ab diluted 1:1000 in ice cold 0.5% BSA/PBS++ to P3, P4, and P5, and incubate for 1 hour on ice.
Wash P3, P4, and P5 five times with ice cold PBS++ (0.5 mL/well) on ice.
Add 1 mL of pre-warmed complete media to P4 and incubate for 10 minutes at 37°C to trigger receptor recycling.
Place P4 on ice for 5–10 min.
Wash P4 once with ice cold PBS++ (0.5 mL/well) on ice.
Add 300 μL of anti-rat HRP-conjugated F(ab’)2 secondary Ab diluted 1:1500 in ice cold 0.5% BSA/PBS++ to P1, P2, P3 and P4.
Incubate for 1 h on ice.
Wash P1, P2, P3 and P4 four times with ice cold PBS++ (0.5 mL/well) on ice.
Track the post-endocytic fate of plasma membrane receptors based on pH measurement of internalized cargo-containing compartments in live cells.
Use a primary antibody that recognizes the extracellular domain of EGFR to label the receptor.
Recognize the labeled EGFR with a pH-sensitive FITC-conjugated secondary Ab.
Determine FITC fluorescence intensities at 490 nm excitation normalized to that at 450 nm excitation (i.e., ratio 490 nm/450 nm).
Use a multi-point pH calibration curve to predict the pH value of the EGFR-containing vesicle.
